newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche says bank merger speculation "overdone".
newsitem.headline: Deutsche says bank merger speculation "overdone".

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG chief executive Rolf Breuer said on Wednesday Deutsche's sharp share price gain was explained by excessive speculation on mergers and acquisitions in the German banking sector.
Asked in an interview with Reuters Financial Television whether the share price rise of more than 10 percent on Wednesday was explained by news of a steep rise in first-half profit, Breuer said:
"No. It is just speculation about new mergers and acquisitions in the banking field in Germany which I feel is a little bit overdone."

Deutsche's shares rose to an all-time high of 134.30 marks in electronic trade on Wednesday, up 13.30 marks or 11 percent, after the bank reported a bigger-than-expected 27.5 percent gain in net income to 1.5 billion marks in the first six months.

Germany's banking sector has been brimming with speculation over further mergers following Monday's announcement of a planned fusion between Bavarian banks Bayerische Vereinsbank AG and Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechsel-Bank AG.
